name: [1 MILLION VISITS EVENT!] My Modded Day
desc:
⭐There is currently a permanent 2x item event, along with a 3x item event that is activated on weekends! ⭐

🖥️ THIS GAME IS PLAYABLE ON Mobile, Computer & XBOX (with Keyboard & Mouse)🖥️✨

❌ WE DO NOT HAVE CONTROLLER SUPPORT. USE MOUSE OR KEYBOARD TO PLAY. ❌

 ❗❗ Welcome to My Modded Day! (MMD) ❗❗

👊 MMD is an action-fighting game inspired by many different games and anime, most notably inspired by the amazing show "Jojo's Bizarre Adventure" made by Hirohiko Araki. ✨

❗  Check the update log in the game to see what's been added.  ❗ 

📝 Game News:
- Dio's Vampirism (Vampire Rework) released!
- Old Map back!

[IMPORTANT]
This game contains assets from "A Bizarre Day", and the code will be rewritten as we go.

[NOTE] 
❗ There are free private servers, we would recommend using them if you want to grind ❗
